text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold winning positions, then bought stocks again later; I should avoid letting my purchase price or the urge to lock in gains drive trades.","I added to positions after prices fell, but a lower price alone is not evidence that a stock is a bargain; with random price moves, I should avoid treating recent declines as a signal.","Frequent trades across all five stocks did not prevent my account value from falling; I should make fewer, deliberate decisions based on portfolio-level risk and my long-term goals."]}
